    Class TpPopover

    <tp-popover> affiche un contenu flottant ancré à un élément cible, sans utiliser de Shadow DOM.

    Exemple :

    <button id="help">Help</button>
    <tp-popover anchor="#help" placement="bottom">
      <p>Popover</p>
    </tp-popover>

    Attributs réactifs :

    • anchor
    • placement
    • offset
    • open
    • backdrop

    Événement :

    • tp-popover-toggle

    Example

    <tp-popover></tp-popover>

    Tagname

    tp-popover

    Attr

    anchor = "" - CSS selector of the anchor element.

    Attr

    placement = "bottom" - Popover placement relative to the anchor.

    Attr

    offset = "8px" - Distance between the anchor and the popover.

    Attr

    open = false - Opens the popover.

    Attr

    backdrop = false - Displays a transparent backdrop behind the popover.

    Attr

    outside-click = false - Closes the popover when the user clicks outside it.

    tp-popover-toggle Emitted when the popover open state changes.

    Eventdetail

    tp-popover-toggle { backdrop: boolean; open: boolean; outsideClick: boolean; anchor: string; placement: "top" | "end" | "bottom" | "start" }
